name: Kahoot!
tagline: Know it. Tap it. Climb the podium.
description: A house quiz with individual play, fixed teams or one cooperative room vote. Discuss together, lock a shape on your phone, then see the answers and standings. Questions appear on your phone when there is no TV.
howToPlay: Read the question and tap its shape once. Correct answers earn speed and streak points.
Teams discuss, then all answer. Team gains average points; highest individual/team wins.
Room vote discusses first, then the most-voted shape becomes one shared answer and score.

settings.label: Teams
settings.description: Balanced fixed teams; limited to the number of players

settings.label: Discussion seconds
settings.description: Teams and room vote discuss before the answer clock; reading time is always reserved
